payload.summary: Addressed PR #704 review threads and CI failures. Acceptance now checks files_modified against the package definition's own scope (the result's scope is a worker echo), a malformed failing step without a name is refused instead of raising KeyError, and result_validator resolves its sibling package_acceptance module when loaded by file path, which fixes the installed-consumer smoke import in test-infra-skills.
completed_work: Thread: compare echoed scope with package definition
Thread: refuse malformed steps instead of KeyError
Thread: bind verdict to result (already done by result_digest in 0e6fa4ca)

decisions.title: Package scope is authoritative at acceptance
decisions.rationale: The echoed result scope is worker-controlled; only package_def scope can bound files_modified. A missing package scope is refused like a skipped commit check, so acceptance stays fail-closed.

decisions.title: Declare apis and documentation context_impact surfaces
decisions.rationale: wp-contract changes the work-queue result schema and wp-integration changes SKILL.md/docs; the context-drift gate flagged them as undeclared.
